appStore.name: BirKare Studio: Product Photos
appStore.subtitle: Catalog & campaign images
appStore.promotionalText: Turn one product photo into a named project and generate real alternatives for a catalog, product page, social ad, or web hero.
appStore.description:
Plan product photos for specific sales channels and manage them in one catalog.

BirKare Studio is a focused product-image workspace for small sellers, boutique shops, and product teams. Instead of a general filter collection, it provides one workflow from a product source photo to deliverable outputs.

CREATE A PRODUCT PROJECT
Name the product, choose its category, and add a clear source photo you have the right to use. The project name and outputs stay together in your product catalog.

PLAN THE INTENDED USE
Start with a marketplace catalog, product page, social ad, or web hero goal. Your choice only prepares a suggested scene and ratio; every setting remains editable before generation.

CHOOSE A SCENE AND FORMAT
Select from product-focused scenes including clean studios, premium surfaces, lifestyle desks, and campaign posters. Use square, portrait, story, or landscape formats.

GENERATE REAL ALTERNATIVES
Request 1, 2, or 4 separate results with the same scene and settings. Quality, alternative count, and the server-confirmed credit cost are shown before generation. Preview supports up to 2 alternatives.

MANAGE YOUR CATALOG
Open completed product outputs, compare alternatives, request a product-safe revision, save, or share. The app does not present a sample result as a completed generation when no real server output exists.

GOOD TO KNOW
AI generation requires an account and internet connection. Results can vary with the source photo and settings. Controls are designed to preserve the product, label, material, and geometry, but review every output before publishing. Compliance with a specific marketplace's technical requirements is not guaranteed. Upload only images you own or have permission to use.

Credits can be purchased separately. Monthly, annual, and lifetime Pro options provide the credits stated in their plan descriptions; they do not include unlimited generation.
